 KEY TAKEAWAYS: 
 India will tour New Zealand from October 22 to December 1, 2026, playing five T20Is, five ODIs and two Tests.
 Sony Sports Network has named a 10-member Extraaa Innings panel led by Ravi Shastri, Sunil Gavaskar and Harsha Bhogle.
 Sky Sport will broadcast the series in New Zealand and will offer Hindi commentary for the whole tour.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement India begin their New Zealand tour with a stacked broadcast line-up
 India start their 2026-27 overseas season in New Zealand on Thursday, October 22. The tour lasts six weeks and covers 12 matches. It is billed as the largest inbound bilateral series that New Zealand Cricket has hosted.
 The series opens with five T20Is between October 22 and November 1. Five ODIs follow from November 4 to 15. Two Tests close the tour, in Wellington from November 19 and in Christchurch from November 27 to December 1.
 Hero VIDA is the title sponsor of the tour, which is part of a programme that marks 100 years of sporting ties between India and New Zealand. The sponsor has naming rights across all 12 matches.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In India, the matches will be shown on Sony Sports Network and streamed on SonyLIV. In New Zealand, Sky Sport has won back the rights from TVNZ. Both broadcasters have now confirmed their commentary teams.

 India vs New Zealand 2026: English and Hindi commentators
 Sony Sports Network has named a 10-member panel for its Extraaa Innings show. Ajinkya Rahane, Ravichandran Ashwin and Shardul Thakur will join Ravi Shastri, Sunil Gavaskar and Harsha Bhogle. Sky Sports will use its team for the New Zealand feed.
 Broadcast
 Commentators & Presenters
 Extraaa Innings (Sony Sports Network) 
 Ravi Shastri, Sunil Gavaskar, Ajinkya Rahane, Ravichandran Ashwin, Shardul Thakur, Ajay Jadeja, Venkatesh Prasad, Ian Smith, Simon Doull, Harsha Bhogle
 English, T20Is and ODIs (Sky Sport) 
 Ian Smith, Ravi Shastri, Stephen Fleming (T20Is only), Simon Doull, Katey Martin, Ross Taylor, Tim Southee, Scott Styris, and Shane Bond
 English, Tests (Sky Sport) 
 Ian Smith, Simon Doull, Sunil Gavaskar, Katey Martin, Harsha Bhogle, Scott Styris
 Hindi (world feed) 
 Ravi Shastri, Sunil Gavaskar, Harsha Bhogle
 Presenter (Sky Sports) 
 Laura McGoldrick
 Sky is offering Hindi commentary for the whole tour for the first time. It has done so in partnership with Sony Pictures Networks India. Shastri leads the white-ball matches , while Gavaskar leads the Tests.

 Start date of the IND vs NZ 2026 series
 The India vs New Zealand series starts on Thursday, October 22, with the first T20I at Hagley Oval in Christchurch. The match begins at 8 p.m. local time, which is 12:30 p.m. in India.

 List of venues for the IND vs NZ 2026 series
 Here are the venues for the India vs New Zealand 2026 series (12 matches):
 Hagley Oval, Christchurch (first and second T20Is and second Test)
 Hnry Stadium, Wellington (third T20I and second ODI)
 Eden Park, Auckland (fourth T20I and first ODI)
 Seddon Park, Hamilton (fifth T20I and third ODI)
 Bay Oval, Tauranga (fourth and fifth ODIs)
 Basin Reserve, Wellington (first Test)
